newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Media, entertainment firms seek S.African partners.
newsitem.headline: Media, entertainment firms seek S.African partners.

text.p: Foreign entertainment, media and communications (EMC) companies looking to expand their markets are actively looking for partners in South Africa, business services company Price Waterhouse said on Thursday.

"Expansion is the name of the game," Wilhelm Krige, head of the company's EMC division in South Africa, told a seminar at the Southern African International Film and Television Market being held in Cape Town.

"Sixty percent of my time currently is being taken up by entertaining overseas EMC companies that are actively out here looking for partners in South Africa... South Africa has become a focus for the international community," Krige said.
He said good weather and relatively cheap costs were also attracting foreign film and television makers.
"I expect to see a lot of companies moving in and utilising South Africa as a place to film movies. Most will want to find partners here."
Krige said local firms would do well to align with the foreign players who had technological and financial resources lacking in South Africa.
